mentions.name: File-level deduplicating container registry
mentions.description: This is a Docker/container registry that deduplicates image data at the file level instead of the layer level, resulting in faster pushes and cheaper storage costs.
mentions.problem: Container registries deduplicate only at the layer level, leading to slower pushes and higher storage costs.
mentions.source_excerpt: A docker/container registry that deduplicates at the file level instead of the layer level. Faster pushes, cheaper storage costs.

evidence.value: A docker/container registry that deduplicates at the file level instead of the layer level. Faster pushes, cheaper storage costs.
